children: Anand brings nearly two decades of experience across rewards, talent management, organisational development and HR transformation

Jaquar & Company Private Limited has appointed Kapil Anand as Head of Total Rewards and HR Transformation, bringing nearly two decades of experience across rewards, talent management, organisational development and business transformation.     Anand's appointment adds an experienced HR professional to Jaquar's management, learning and development, employee engagement and HR business partnering. His career includes both in-house HR leadership and consulting roles across multiple sectors.
Before joining Jaquar, Anand served as Head of Organisation Development and Talent Management at Century Plyboards (I) Limited for more than two years.

Earlier, he worked at WTW as Principal and North Head for Rewards and Talent Consulting, advising organisations on talent and rewards strategies. Between 2020 and 2023, Anand worked as an HR Transformation and Organisation Development Consultant, supporting organisations across FMCG, healthcare, apparel manufacturing and financial analytics.

His earlier roles include Head Talent & OD, Southeast Asia at ByteDance; AGM, Business HR, OD, Talent Management & Learning at Essel Infraprojects; Group Leader, HR at Ester Industries; Manager, HR at AkzoNobel; Assistant Manager at Bank of America; and Academic Counsellor and Faculty Member at IMS Learning Resources.
Across these roles, Anand has worked across talent management, organisational development, learning and development, employee engagement, recruitment and HR business partnering.

His new mandate at Jaquar brings together his experience in total rewards and organisational transformation, with the role covering two areas central to HR strategy — how organisations structure rewards and how people practices evolve alongside broader organisational needs.

Jaquar & Company Private Limited is part of the Jaquar Group and operates in the bathroom and lighting solutions market. The company has more than 65 years of business history, is headquartered in Manesar, Gurugram, and has a presence across more than 55 countries.
Anand's appointment adds an experienced HR professional to Jaquar's people leadership team as he takes charge of total rewards and HR transformation.
